_doc: Real `sinatra-contrib-4.2.1/lib/sinatra/json.rb` vendored 1:1 under `vendor/sinatra/json.rb`. Third sinatra-contrib fixture; first to exercise the `application/json` content-type path end-to-end. Routes through the standard multi_json shim (shared with sinatra_jsonp_smoke) which delegates to rubyrs's built-in JSON canon on the rubyrs side and the real multi_json gem on CRuby. Tests cover flat/nested/array/primitive shapes, per-call content_type override, and the block-form `set :json_encoder do; ::MultiJson; end` arity-0 deferred-value path (sinatra_lite's `set` now distinguishes arity 0 from arity >= 1).
name: sinatra_json_smoke
